operation.name: synthstar
operation.description:
Fixes imperfect stars from the loaded image. No matter how much coma, tracking drift or other distortion your stars have, if Siril's star finder routine can detect it, synthstar will fix it. To use intensive care, you may wish to manually detect all the stars you wish to fix. This can be done using the findstar console command or the Dynamic PSF dialog. If you have not run star detection, it will be run automatically with default settings.

For best results synthstar should be run before stretching.

The output of synthstar is a fully corrected synthetic star mask comprising perfectly round star PSFs (Moffat or Gaussian profiles depending on star saturation) computed to match the intensity, FWHM, hue and saturation measured for each star detected in the input image. This can then be recombined with the starless image to produce an image with perfect stars.

No parameters are required for this command

Links: psf

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.

Links: psf

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.

Siril star measurements are prepared with findstar on the fixed image before synthstar.

runtime is a JSON object. Supported keys: ini, settings, threads, memory_ratio, output_bits, compression, online, selection, findstar, photometry. Networking starts offline and must be enabled explicitly. Selection is omitted for the whole image or explicitly null to clear it; optional CLI arguments use separate use_* controls. Connect transforms to an explicit export, stacking, or analysis endpoint. Only requested dependencies are executed; previews do not make other branches endpoints. Saved output references identify complete checked files, never preview pixels. See reference/coverage.json and docs/usage.md.
